raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The 24 REVERSAL rows (status 'REVERSAL', orig_txn_id set, positive amounts) point at original transactions from the most recent days. Those originals are still status 'POSTED', so silver_transactions keeps them and gold totals run higher than settlement. Older originals have already been flipped to 'REVERSED' and are filtered out. The fix is to exclude any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL row references.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions x WHERE x.status = 'REVERSAL' AND x.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
